newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton ends touch lower, awaits USDA estimate.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton ends touch lower, awaits USDA estimate.

text.p: NYCE cotton ended weaker in dull, rangebound trading as the market stayed on an even keel during the December options expiry on Friday.
Traders said dealings were generally featureless and that the market was waiting for Tuesday's USDA crop estimate report.
Players "did not want to be out on a limb" before the estimate was released in case they were wrongfooted, traders added.
December cotton settled 0.23 cent weaker at 71.31 cents per pound, traded 71.90 to 71.26 cents.
Volume was estimated at 6,000 lots, down from Thursday's official 8,638 lots.
